snippet.title: Friendly Pharmacy - Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Meet Willow. Her day starts with a smile. It doesn't stay quiet for long.

Wishlist Friendly Pharmacy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391800/

Friendly Pharmacy is a slapstick pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Work solo or team up in online co-op as robot pharmacists: decipher dreadful prescriptions, operate absurd machines, and get the right medicine to the right patient. When the equipment jams and the mess starts spreading, teamwork is your best treatment.

Enjoy this cinematic introduction to Willow and the chaos waiting just beyond the counter.

Coming soon to Steam. Wishlist now and subscribe for more trailers, development updates, and pharmacy mayhem.

Developed by a solo dev, this is also the first ever cinematic trailer I have done. Developed in Blender and Unreal. 

#FriendlyPharmacy #CoopGame #IndieGame
